name: Ty Jerome
headline: Ty Jerome is averaging 34.7 points on 69% true shooting and has Memphis sitting at 3-0.
good: Scoring binge: 34.7 points, 5.7 assists and 4.3 rebounds per game in 32 minutes across three starts, with a 45-point opener against Utah (17-of-25, 5-of-10 from three).
Efficiency is elite: 56.2% from the field, 42.9% from three, 88.5% from the line and a 68.9% true shooting mark, even with a 34.1% usage rate.
He was perfect at the line against Sacramento, going 14-of-14 on the way to 31 points and a +27 mark, and he is averaging +19.7 per game overall.
His grade in the dashboard is an A+ (95), with production and efficiency both called out.
bad: Turnovers can spike: he had 4 against Golden State while shooting 11-of-22 for 28 points, and he averages 2.0 per game.
The three-point shot was cold against Sacramento (1-of-6) and he needed 17 shots for his 8 field goals, so some of that night's scoring came from free throws.
It is only three games, so the shooting and the 34.1% usage are very likely to come down, and the grade itself flags the small sample.
fans: The local coverage from the last few days is built around Jerome. The ESPN recap of the Kings game led with his 31 points and 14-for-14 free throw line. Earlier Daily Memphian coverage from his debut season framed him as a guard who gives fans what they want to see. I could not find fresh subreddit or beat writer threads from the past two weeks, so I am not claiming more than that.
outlook: Expect Memphis to lean on him as the lead guard again Monday night at Utah (tip is 9:00 PM ET, Jazz favored by 1.5 per DraftKings), a rematch of the 123-103 Memphis win on Oct 21 when he scored 45. Some regression in his shooting is likely, but the volume and role look secure for now.
